about: Comox Valley C (Puntledge–Black Creek) is a regional district electoral area on eastern Vancouver Island—not the City of Courtenay, Town of Comox, or Village of Cumberland. Rural communities such as Black Creek, Merville, Puntledge, and Saratoga–Miracle Beach sit between the Puntledge River country and the Oyster River. About 9,000 people live in Electoral Area C.
seoSummary: Rural Comox Valley electoral area—Black Creek, Merville, and Miracle Beach, not Courtenay or Comox.
